title: Flood hazard extent T=50 yr (Floods Directive, Greece)
attribution: © Υπουργείο Περιβάλλοντος & Ενέργειας / Ειδική Γραμματεία Υδάτων — Σχέδια Διαχείρισης Κινδύνων Πλημμύρας (Οδηγία 2007/60/ΕΚ), gis.floods.ypeka.gr
notes: Source: Greek Ministry of Environment & Energy (YPEN) FRMP geoportal GeoServer, workspace floods_rev1 (Floods Directive 2nd cycle / 1st revision). CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * returned on GetMap. Layers elNN_friv_0050_rev1 ('Όρια Πλημμυρών (Τ=50)'): modelled fluvial flood inundation extent for return period 50 years within the APSFRs. Blue outline + light-blue fill.

title: Flood risk (impact assessment) T=100 yr (Floods Directive, Greece)
attribution: © Υπουργείο Περιβάλλοντος & Ενέργειας / Ειδική Γραμματεία Υδάτων — Σχέδια Διαχείρισης Κινδύνων Πλημμύρας (Οδηγία 2007/60/ΕΚ), gis.floods.ypeka.gr

CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * returned on GetMap. Legend: https://gis.floods.ypeka.gr/geoserver/floods_rev1/wms?service=WMS&version=1.1.1&request=GetLegendGraphic&format=image/png&layer=<one layer name>. Layers elNN_risk_0100 ('Αποτίμηση των επιπτώσεων πλημμυρών (T=100)'), default style el_risk_risk (green→yellow→orange→red risk classes with black block outlines). title: JRC/EFAS European river flood hazard (combined return-period scenarios)
attribution: © European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service — EFAS / JRC flood hazard maps
notes: Copernicus EMS EFAS public WMS (no token needed for this layer). Layer 'Flood Inundation Scenarios' = JRC pan-European river flood hazard maps (100 m, EFAS-based) with return periods combined into one classed raster (blue shades: darker = more frequent). ~100 m resolution so coarse vs. national FD maps. CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

title: JRC/GloFAS global flood hazard T=100 yr
attribution: © European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service — GloFAS / JRC
notes: Copernicus EMS GloFAS public WMS. 'Inundated areas for flood events with a return period of 100 years, based on GloFAS climatology' (JRC global river flood hazard map, ~90 m) plus permanent water bodies. CORS: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.
